verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM publishes a first-party 'Custom Agent Skill Developer Guide' and advertises 'Custom Agent Skills' as a feature, so developers have a documented format for writing their own skills. The product runs locally or self-hosted, so those skills load into the developer's own instance. MCP compatibility documentation adds a second documented route for plugging in tools. Missing for 10: the evidence contains only page titles, with no detail on the skill format, file layout or loading steps, and no hands-on or community confirmation that custom skills load and work.
